subject: Re: Packaging for uptime guarantees and on-call coverage
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@heliumanalytics.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.com
Cc: Carol Diaz <carol@heliumanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Uptime guarantees and on-call packaging — can you send options?

Michael,

We’re wrapping up our vendor evaluation for inference serving. Two quick asks before we push this to procurement: 1) a clear breakdown of uptime tiers you offer and how credits are calculated for downtime, and 2) what on-call/engineer escalation coverage looks like for P1/P2 incidents (is an engineer included or only remote support?).

Our baseline needs: production traffic in US-West, multi-region failover later this year, and a preference for a single-line commercial commitment (monthly or annual). If you have a one-page table that lays out 99.5 / 99.9 / 99.95-like bands with response SLAs and retainer pricing, that’d be ideal.

Thanks —
Alex
Alex Morgan
Director of Platform Engineering, Helium Analytics
From: michael.grant@redwood.com <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@heliumanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-04-13T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Uptime guarantees and on-call packaging — can you send options?

Alex —

Thanks for the note. I’ve put together three pragmatic packaging options (attached: SLA_pricing_grid_v1.pdf) to match common patterns we see with customers at your scale. High-level summary: 

• Standard Assurance: 99.5% monthly uptime, P1 acknowledgment in 8 hours, P1 response in 4 business hours, no dedicated retainer (best for low-cost/low-risk workloads).
• Assured: 99.9% monthly uptime, P1 acknowledgment in 2 hours, P1 response within 2 hours, 8x5 remote retainer included ($4k/mo).
• Assured Plus: 99.95% monthly uptime, P1 on-call engineer engagement (follow-the-sun), 24/7 response within 1 hour, dedicated retainer (on-call rotation) + annual onboarding support ($14k/mo).

Credit model: simple minute-based credits capped at 50% of monthly service fee for Standard, 100% for Assured, and 150% for Assured Plus — details in the attached grid. We can layer multi-region failover as an add-on (typically +0.2% SLA uplift if customers run an active-passive failover with our recommended configuration).

If you’re evaluating committed-spend discounts, we usually offer a 10-20% ramp depending on term and commit. I can sketch a committed discount table if you share a target ARR/commitment for year 1.

I’m copying Grace (Customer Reliability) who can speak to onboarding and whether an engineer is embedded during first 90 days.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Morgan <alex@heliumanalytics.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.com
Cc: Carol Diaz <carol@heliumanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-04-14T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Uptime guarantees and on-call packaging — can you send options?

Michael —

Appreciate the table. A couple of follow-ups:

1) If we commit to a 2-year contract with an annualized spend target, what level of discount and onboarding credits would you consider? We’re looking for something north of 15% in the first year to make the economics work.
2) For Assured Plus, does the 24/7 engineer engagement include guaranteed engineer response (not just triage by support)? We need a rotation that can escalate to our SREs and, if necessary, join war rooms.
3) Do you have a hard cap on credits or a reconciliation cadence (monthly vs quarterly)?

Also: procurement asked for SOC 2 documentation and a SOC 2 completion timeline if Redwood doesn’t already have a report we can see.

We have a small compliance worksheet attached (SOX_readiness_checklist.xlsx) that lists the evidence they’ll request.

— Alex
From: michael.grant@redwood.com <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@heliumanalytics.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-15T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Uptime guarantees and on-call packaging — can you send options?

Alex —

Looping in Grace (Customer Reliability) and Rishi (Head of Sales) to lock down engineering engagement and the commercial trade-offs. Concretely: 

• Discount: we can extend a 15% first-year discount for a 24-month committed ARR baseline; if you push to 36 months we can go to 22% (subject to deal desk).
• On-call / Assured Plus: the on-call component is an SLA-backed on-call rotation — guaranteed engineer engagement within 60 minutes of escalation for P1s, with an escalation path to our senior SREs. We will include 3 dedicated on-call shifts weekly (not named individuals) as part of the retainer; individual engineers rotate. We also offer an optional embedded SRE for the first 90 days at a one-time onboarding fee ($25k) to shadow and hand off runbooks.
• Credits: monthly reconciliation with a cap equal to 100% of the monthly committed fee for Assured and 150% for Assured Plus. We prefer monthly so we can reconcile quickly, but quarterly is possible for enterprise procurement processes.

I’ve attached a short mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_helium_v2.docx) — it mirrors the onboarding and escalation steps and has a timeline for SOC 2 evidence requests. For SOC 2: we have a Type II in progress with a projected delivery in Q3; in the meantime we can provide a security questionnaire and architecture diagram.

Next step: I can convert this into a term sheet and send via DocuSign. Rishi, approve the initial discount band and DocuSign flow?

Thanks,
Michael
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex@heliumanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-04-16T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Uptime guarantees and on-call packaging — can you send options?

Michael / Grace —

Approve the 15% first-year discount for a 24-month commitment. Confirm embedded SRE is optional and priced separately (25k onboarding). For credits: cap Assured at 100% and Assured Plus at 150% of monthly committed fee. Please send term sheet and DocuSign link to Alex; include explicit language about monthly reconciliation and interruption taxonomy (P0/P1/P2 definitions).

Rishi
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Morgan <alex@heliumanalytics.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-17T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Uptime guarantees and on-call packaging — can you send options?

Team —

Thanks — this looks acceptable. We’ll proceed on a 24-month committed plan with Assured Plus but want embedded SRE for the first 90 days. Please route the final term sheet and DocuSign to procurement (procurement@heliumanalytics.com) and attach any SOC 2 interim evidence you can share. If procurement is good, we will issue PO within 5 business days.

Please include the DocuSign link and the HubSpot record in the package so our legal team has everything in one place.

— Alex
